title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Metropolitan Opera House, Philadelphia | 2019
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Metropolitan Opera House in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, USA, on 14 August 2019.

It was the 22nd show of the 14th All-Starr Band’s tour of Asia and North America, which lasted for 34 dates between March and September 2019.

Starr returned to the Metropolitan Opera House on 11 September 2022.

The 14th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, piano
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar, harmonica
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
